shortDescription: Catcher Predict reported a sharp decline in the Jaguars’ probability in Polymarket’s “Texans vs. Jaguars” “2H Spread -5.5” market. According to ChainCatcher, the probability fell to 30.5% from 50% one hour earlier, a drop of 19.5 percentage points.
